name: story
description: Route STORY requests to the project's master's or doctoral thesis workflow skills.

interface.shortDescription: Route a request to one STORY thesis workflow.
interface.longDescription: Adds the /story router for choosing and running one STORY master's or doctoral thesis workflow skill in the current project, and /story-auto for pursuing a stated thesis goal across the unmarked skills, stopping at any explicit-only one.
